crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin holds near $73,000 at the 200-day average
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin closed Nov 12 between about $72,900 and $73,900, testing the $72,000 to $74,000 zone and the 200-day moving average near $73,200 as traders split on a retest of $70,000 to $72,000 or a quick bounce.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lose $300 million on Nov 11
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $299.9 million in net outflows on Nov 11, led by BlackRock's IBIT, extending a five-day streak to $1.44 billion. Ethereum ETFs lost $144.8 million the same day.

crypto_headlines.title: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in 30 days
crypto_headlines.summary: Stablecoin supply shrank by $14.2 billion over 30 days, the sharpest fall since 2022, with total supply dipping below $290 billion and DeFi TVL down to about $78 billion.

crypto_headlines.title: NYSE approves Pyth as a distributor of its market data
crypto_headlines.summary: Pyth became an approved distributor of NYSE market data on Nov 11, bringing real-time top-of-book quotes across five NYSE Group equity markets to onchain apps, following its September Nasdaq approval.

doginal_news.title: Floor holds at 45k DOGE with no sale since Nov 3
doginal_news.summary: Wednesday evening the floor was still 45k DOGE (about $3.0k) with 17 asks and no sale since #495 at 115k on Nov 3.

doginal_news.title: Doginal Dogs Black Friday sale teased
doginal_news.summary: Vee told the pack to prepare for the Doginal Dogs Black Friday sale, with a DD purse in the preview.

doginal_news.title: First GEM-MT 10 Bark card
doginal_news.summary: A Legends TCG Bark card sent to AGS came back GEM-MT 10, the first perfect grade of five Bark cards graded so far.

doginal_news.title: Championship players get Victorious Gary promo
doginal_news.summary: Everyone playing in the first official DDLTCG Championship gets an exclusive Giga Rare Victorious Gary promo.

doginal_news.title: Pyth team at The Big Whale Geneva Summit
doginal_news.summary: Pyth is on the ground at The Big Whale Geneva Summit 2026 with a workshop on always-on markets, institutional pricing and AI data needs.

notes: No new posts from the official Doginal Dogs or DDLTCG accounts in the last day; items come from community posts.
